about: Held-out cases for the docs classifier, built on 2026-09-30 from changelog entries that the spike cases did not use. Each case rebuilds the shape of a real Claude Code docs change, trimmed to a few lines. `label` is the label of the builder. `cited` is the rule that cites the block, or null for a block that no rule cites. A case with `removed: true` needs no model call. `heldout-key.json` maps the blind ids to these cases.

cases.source: changelog: added a `MessageDisplay` hook event that transforms or hides assistant message text
cases.heading: Hook lifecycle
cases.old:
## Hook lifecycle

Hooks fire at these events. Write the event name exactly as shown.

- `SessionStart`
- `UserPromptSubmit`
- `PreToolUse`
- `PostToolUse`
- `Stop`
- `StopFailure`
cases.new:
## Hook lifecycle

Hooks fire at these events. Write the event name exactly as shown.

- `SessionStart`
- `UserPromptSubmit`
- `PreToolUse`
- `PostToolUse`
- `Stop`
- `StopFailure`
- `MessageDisplay`: fires as assistant message text is displayed. A hook can transform or hide the text.
cases.label: rule-update

cases.source: changelog: added `CwdChanged` and `FileChanged` hook events for reactive environment management
cases.heading: hooks
cases.old:
## hooks

The `hooks` field takes a path to a hooks file or an inline object. Keys are event names, for example `SessionStart`, `PreToolUse` and `Stop`.
cases.new:
## hooks

The `hooks` field takes a path to a hooks file or an inline object. Keys are event names, for example `SessionStart`, `PreToolUse`, `Stop`, `CwdChanged` and `FileChanged`.

`CwdChanged` and `FileChanged` let a hook reload the environment, for example with direnv.
cases.label: rule-update

cases.source: changelog: config default stated in parentheses (shape of a changed default), applied to the skill listing limit
cases.heading: Skill descriptions are cut short
cases.old:
## Skill descriptions are cut short

Claude Code cuts each skill's `description` plus `when_to_use` in the skill listing. The default limit is 1,536 characters. Set `skillListingMaxDescChars` to change it.
cases.new:
## Skill descriptions are cut short

Claude Code cuts each skill's `description` plus `when_to_use` in the skill listing. The default limit is 3,000 characters. Set `skillListingMaxDescChars` to change it.
cases.label: rule-update

cases.source: changelog: plugins warn when a default component folder (for example `commands/`) is ignored because `plugin.json` sets the matching key
cases.heading: commands
cases.old:
## commands

`commands`: path or paths to extra command files or directories, relative to the plugin root. Claude Code also reads the `commands/` directory.
cases.new:
## commands

`commands`: path or paths to command files or directories, relative to the plugin root. Default: `commands/`.

When you set this field, Claude Code does not read the default `commands/` directory. Add `./commands/` to the list to keep it.
cases.label: rule-update

cases.source: changelog: removed the one-hour time limit on background commands started by subagents (shape of a limit that is gone)
cases.hard: new text negates an earlier requirement
cases.heading: Skill descriptions are cut short
cases.old:
## Skill descriptions are cut short

Claude Code cuts the `description` plus `when_to_use` text at 1,536 characters in the skill listing. Put the main use case first.
cases.new:
## Skill descriptions are cut short

Claude Code no longer cuts skill descriptions in the listing. The full `description` and `when_to_use` text loads, and no length limit applies.
cases.label: rule-removal

Check that the event name matches exactly, including case. `PostToolUse` works. `posttooluse` does not.

cases.source: changelog: plugin slash commands resolve to a namespaced form (shape of a form that is fully supported, not deprecated)
cases.heading: Commands
cases.old:
## Commands

The `commands/` directory holds legacy flat Markdown files. A skill in `skills/` replaces a command file. Migrate command files to skills.
cases.new:
## Commands

The `commands/` directory holds flat Markdown command files. The plugin name namespaces each one, for example `/myplugin review`. Command files are a supported form and Claude Code does not deprecate them. Use `skills/` when a command needs supporting files.
cases.label: rule-removal

cases.source: changelog: added hook `args: string[]` field (exec form) that spawns the command without a shell
cases.heading: Command hook fields
cases.old:
## Command hook fields

A command hook sets `type: "command"` and `command`, a shell string. Quote path placeholders such as `"${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"`.
cases.new:
## Command hook fields

A command hook sets `type: "command"` and `command`, a shell string. Quote path placeholders such as `"${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"`.

A command hook can set `args` instead, an array of strings. Claude Code spawns the program directly without a shell, so path placeholders need no quotes. Set `command` or `args`, not both.
cases.label: new-rule

cases.source: changelog: added `experimental.cacheTtl` (`"5m"` or `"1h"`) to agent frontmatter
cases.heading: Supported frontmatter fields
cases.old:
## Supported frontmatter fields

- `name`: required. Lowercase letters and hyphens.
- `description`: required. When Claude should use the agent.
- `tools`: optional list of tools.
- `model`: optional model alias.
cases.new:
## Supported frontmatter fields

- `name`: required. Lowercase letters and hyphens.
- `description`: required. When Claude should use the agent.
- `tools`: optional list of tools.
- `model`: optional model alias.
- `experimental.cacheTtl`: optional prompt cache TTL for this agent. Allowed values are `"5m"` and `"1h"`.
cases.label: new-rule

cases.source: changelog: added `keep-coding-instructions` frontmatter field support for plugin output styles
cases.heading: Output style frontmatter
cases.old:
## Output style frontmatter

An output style is a Markdown file. Its frontmatter sets `name` and `description`.
cases.new:
## Output style frontmatter

An output style is a Markdown file. Its frontmatter sets `name` and `description`. Plugin output styles can also set `keep-coding-instructions`, a boolean. When it is `true`, the style keeps the coding parts of the system prompt.
cases.label: new-rule

cases.source: changelog: added `bashOutputMaxChars` and `taskOutputMaxChars` settings, up to 128K characters
cases.heading: Available settings
cases.old:
## Available settings

- `cleanupPeriodDays`: days to keep session files. Integer.
- `model`: default model.
cases.new:
## Available settings

- `cleanupPeriodDays`: days to keep session files. Integer.
- `model`: default model.
- `bashOutputMaxChars`: characters of command output that Claude receives inline before the rest goes to a file. Integer, at most 128000.
cases.label: new-rule

cases.source: changelog: skill frontmatter `display-name`, `default-enabled`, `fallback` and `metadata.*` accept kebab-case, snake_case and camelCase
cases.hard: nearby field that the rule does not read
cases.heading: Frontmatter reference
cases.old:
## Frontmatter reference

- `description`: what the skill does and when to use it.
- `when_to_use`: extra trigger text. Counts toward the listing limit with `description`.
- `display-name`: name shown in menus. Write it in kebab-case.
- `default-enabled`: whether the skill starts on. Write it in kebab-case.
cases.new:
## Frontmatter reference

- `description`: what the skill does and when to use it.
- `when_to_use`: extra trigger text. Counts toward the listing limit with `description`.
- `display-name`: name shown in menus. Also accepted as `display_name` and `displayName`.
- `default-enabled`: whether the skill starts on. Also accepted as `default_enabled` and `defaultEnabled`.
cases.label: no-change

cases.source: changelog: `CLAUDE_CODE_SESSIONEND_HOOKS_TIMEOUT_MS` now extends SessionEnd hooks that set no per-hook `timeout`
cases.hard: looks measurable but is runtime behavior
cases.heading: SessionEnd
cases.old:
## SessionEnd

Claude Code cancels a SessionEnd hook after 1.5 seconds. A hook can set `timeout` to raise the limit.
cases.new:
## SessionEnd

Claude Code cancels a SessionEnd hook after 1.5 seconds. A hook can set `timeout` to raise the limit. The environment variable `CLAUDE_CODE_SESSIONEND_HOOKS_TIMEOUT_MS` also raises the limit for hooks that set no `timeout`.
cases.label: no-change

cases.source: changelog: fixed hooks with comma-separated matchers (for example `Bash,PowerShell`) silently never firing
cases.hard: nearby cause removed in a cited block
cases.heading: Hook loads but never fires
cases.old:
## Hook loads but never fires

- The event name differs in case. Use `PostToolUse`, not `posttooluse`.
- A matcher is a comma-separated list such as `Bash,PowerShell`. Use `Bash|PowerShell`.
- The script is not executable. Run `chmod +x` on it.
cases.new:
## Hook loads but never fires

- The event name differs in case. Use `PostToolUse`, not `posttooluse`.
- The script is not executable. Run `chmod +x` on it.
cases.label: no-change
